svg.aria-label: A KD-tree links branch tests to spatial regions Panel: Follow the branch conditions Panel: Locate the same leaf in space First leaf visited by $q = (2, 1)$ Root: $x < 5$?; n = 8 $x < 5$? → $y < 4$? (left child); branch: $x < 5$; n = 4 $x < 5$? → $y < 6$? (right child); branch: $x \ge 5$; n = 4 $y < 4$? → A, B (left child); branch: $y < 4$; n = 2; First leaf visited $y < 4$? → C, D (right child); branch: $y \ge 4$; n = 2 $y < 6$? → E, F (left child); branch: $y < 6$; n = 2 $y < 6$? → G, H (right child); branch: $y \ge 6$; n = 2 Highlighted path: $x < 5$? → $y < 4$? → A, B The route chooses the first leaf to inspect. Exact nearest-neighbor search may backtrack to another region. The same splits partition feature space Feature x: 0 to 10 Feature y: 0 to 10 Training samples (scatter): a A (1, 1); b B (3, 2); c C (2, 5); d D (4, 7); e E (6, 2); f F (8, 4); g G (7, 7); h H (9, 8) Query q (scatter): q q (2, 1) Root split: $x = 5$: (5, 0) → (5, 10) Left split: $y = 4$: (0, 4) → (5, 4) Right split: $y = 6$: (5, 6) → (10, 6) First leaf visited: A, B: x 0 to 5, y 0 to 4 A is nearest: $d = 1$: (2, 1) → (1, 1) The root split spans the domain. Each horizontal split stops at its parent region. A is the nearest sample to q. $q = (2, 1)$ enters the lower-left leaf A, B. A is nearest at distance 1; exact search also checks whether backtracking is needed.
